strings.请先从插件市场安装对应插件: Install the corresponding plugin from the market first
strings.等待 Windows 授权；仅提升只读传感器采集进程: Waiting for Windows permission; only the read-only sensor collector is elevated
strings.无法启动授权采集，请重试: Could not start the elevated collector. Please retry
strings.无法连接核心服务，正在重试: Could not connect to the core service. Retrying
strings.0–100% · 2 秒采样 · 不可用时留空: 0–100% · Sampled every 2 seconds · Blank when unavailable
strings.接收器存在不代表无线设备本体在线。普通有线耳机显示系统音频端点，无法仅凭声卡识别: A connected receiver does not mean its wireless device is online. Standard wired headphones appear as system audio endpoints; the sound card cannot identify the headphone model. DPI, polling rate, firmware and proprietary wireless battery data require model-specific protocol support. Bluetooth battery data from Windows may be cached.
strings.逻辑槽位未与 PnP 物理设备建立对应关系，可能与上方 HID 接口属于同一手柄: This logical slot has not been matched to a physical PnP device. It may belong to the same controller as an HID interface above.
strings.按物理设备合并接口；接收器存在不代表无线本体在线。: Interfaces are grouped by physical device. A receiver does not confirm that its wireless device is online.
strings.设备选择失败，请重试: Could not select the device. Please retry
strings.模拟参数已保存，未发送硬件命令: Simulation saved. No hardware commands were sent
strings.按键映射\n左键 / 右键 / 中键 / 侧键；具体映射能力需真实协议验证。:
Button mapping
Left / right / middle / side buttons. Actual mapping support requires protocol verification.
strings.手柄映射与状态\nA / B / X / Y、方向键、左右摇杆与扳机。旧版协议与:
Controller mapping & status
A / B / X / Y, D-pad, sticks and triggers. Legacy protocols and software mapping require further verification.
strings.硬件 EQ 与电量能力尚未验证。通用 EQ 按应用和系统输出端点配置。: Hardware EQ and battery support have not been verified. Universal EQ uses applications and system output endpoints.
strings.Windows 未提供该设置页面: Windows does not provide this settings page
strings.FxSound 正在使用虚拟音频设备，请退出 FxSound 后使用 H hub: FxSound is using the virtual audio device. Exit FxSound before using H hub effects
strings.曲线编辑可用 · 远程会话未暴露虚拟音频端点，实时应用处理未启动: Curve editing available · No virtual audio endpoint in this remote session; live processing is stopped
strings.驱动已安装，但当前会话没有可访问的虚拟音频端点；实时链路未启用: Driver installed, but this session has no accessible virtual audio endpoint. Live processing is stopped
strings.尚未安装虚拟音频路由驱动，处理链路不可启动: Install the virtual audio routing driver to start processing
strings.\n当前 Windows 不支持自动应用路由: Automatic application routing is unavailable on this Windows version
strings.原声输出恢复尚未通过回传，稍后会自动重试: Original output restoration is not confirmed yet. Retrying shortly
strings.已停止 EQ，应用输出恢复已回读: EQ stopped. Application output restoration confirmed
strings.请先选择应用与耳机或扬声器: Select an application and headphones or speakers first
strings.请先退出 FxSound，再使用 Hhub 的虚拟音频端点，无需重复安装驱动。: Exit FxSound first, then use the Hhub virtual audio endpoint. The driver does not need to be reinstalled.
strings.驱动已安装，但当前远程会话没有暴露本地音频端点。请在本地桌面使用实时 EQ；此处: Driver installed, but this remote session does not expose local audio endpoints. Use the local desktop for live EQ. Curves can still be edited and saved here.
strings.驱动已安装，请在 Windows 声音设置中确认 Hhub Audio 端点可用: Driver installed. Check that Hhub Audio is available in Windows sound settings. If the component is damaged, reinstall the driver from the plugin.
strings.通用 EQ 插件包含 FxSound 官方签名虚拟音频驱动的安装程序。安装需要管: The Universal EQ plugin includes the installer for the officially signed FxSound virtual audio driver. Installation requires administrator permission and may require a restart. Curve editing and preset saving work without it.
strings.EQ 参数未通过回读: EQ settings were not confirmed by readback
strings.参数已回传；音频生效状态见面板下方: Settings confirmed. See processing status below
strings.首个前台应用路径（更多应用在场景详情添加）: First foreground app path (add more in scene details)
strings.场景优先级 · 数值越大越优先: Scene priority · Higher values take precedence
strings.正式版兼容模式会以普通用户权限运行插件，可访问用户文件和网络。当前只保存偏好，不: In the full release, compatibility mode runs plugins as the current user and permits file and network access. This currently saves a preference only; no code is executed.
strings.将移除 Windows 设置插件、侧边栏入口和回退记录。已经应用的 Window: Remove the Windows settings plugin, its sidebar entry and rollback records. Windows settings already applied will remain unchanged.
strings.将停止服务、移除侧边栏入口并清理此插件的配置。手机配对与授权也会清除，重新安装后: Stop the service, remove the sidebar entry and clear this plugin's settings. Phone pairings and permissions will also be removed; reinstalling requires setup again.
strings.将停止并移除插件安装状态。开发者项目保留，重新导入安装包后可继续开发。: Stop the plugin and remove its installation records. Developer projects are retained; import the package again to continue development.
strings.请先完成当前插件安装: Finish the current plugin installation first
strings.离线页面插件会加载包中的页面脚本，仅在你确认安装后导入，设备访问受声明权限和型号: The plugin page executes scripts from the local package; install only code you trust. Device communication is limited by permissions and model contracts. Ordinary packages register metadata only. Native plugins also validate and install their declared runtime components. The EQ driver requires separate confirmation and administrator permission.
strings.插件已安装，可以从插件卡片打开: Plugin installed. Open it from its card
strings.本地插件元信息已登记，没有执行硬件代码: Local plugin metadata registered. No hardware code was executed
strings.松开以安装插件包: Release to install the plugin package
strings.每次请拖入一个插件包: Drop one plugin package at a time
strings.请拖入文件，不能拖入文件夹: Drop a plugin file, not a folder
strings.没有匹配的应用，可尝试显示后台进程: No matching apps. Try showing background processes
strings.\n将更新插件组件并保留现有配置。: Plugin components will be updated and settings retained.
strings.\n将更新插件元信息与离线页面。: Plugin metadata and offline pages will be updated.
strings.\n包含虚拟音频驱动安装程序；安装需另行确认管理员授权，可能重启。: Includes a virtual audio driver installer; installation requires separate administrator permission and may require a restart.
strings.手机遥控已关闭。打开右上角开关，即可启用局域网连接。: Phone remote is off. Use the switch at the top right to enable LAN access.
strings.手机扫码访问本机 HTTPS 页面，提交配对码后在电脑端批准。默认只允许查看状态: Scan the code on your phone to open this PC's HTTPS page. Submit the pairing code and approve it on the PC. Viewing is allowed by default; peripheral, scene and EQ controls require separate permission.
strings.HTTPS 服务已启用；仅为专用网络配置本地子网防火墙规则: HTTPS enabled. Firewall access is limited to the local subnet on private networks
strings.启用时仅配置本程序的专用网络规则，不更改网络类别。: Only this application's private-network firewall rule is configured. The network category is not changed.
strings.未发现局域网 IPv4 地址，当前地址只能在电脑本机访问。: No LAN IPv4 address found. This address is accessible only on this PC.
strings.配对码有效期 5 分钟；每个请求等待电脑批准最多 3 分钟。: Pairing codes expire after 5 minutes. Requests wait for PC approval for up to 3 minutes.
strings.用 H hub App 或系统扫码打开；地址、配对码及证书指纹自动填入: Open with H hub App or the system scanner; address, code and certificate fingerprint are filled in automatically
strings.首次访问使用本机自签名证书，手机浏览器可能要求确认。请核对电脑地址及证书指纹，再: The first connection uses this PC's self-signed certificate. Your phone browser may ask for confirmation. Verify the PC address and certificate fingerprint before approving.
strings.暂无请求。手机提交配对码后，请在这里批准。: No requests. Submit a pairing code on your phone to request approval here.
strings.允许外设、场景与 EQ 操作: Allow peripheral, scene and EQ controls
strings.授权已撤销，原连接令牌立即失效: Access revoked. The previous connection token is invalid
strings.Wi-Fi 不可用时，在手机开启蓝牙网络共享，在 Windows 蓝牙设备设置连: If Wi-Fi is unavailable, enable Bluetooth tethering on your phone, then connect to its personal area network (PAN) in Windows Bluetooth settings. Refresh the connection service, select the Bluetooth adapter address and scan again. HTTPS and PC approval still apply; Bluetooth pairing alone does not create a network.
strings.手机需能访问所选电脑地址。Hyper-V NAT 网卡可能需要主机转发端口或外部: Your phone must be able to reach the selected PC address. A Hyper-V NAT adapter may require host port forwarding or an external switch. Public networks are not automatically changed to private. Mark only trusted LANs as private.
strings.均衡器曲线：左右键调频，上下键调增益: EQ curve: left/right to change frequency, up/down to change gain
strings.打开 H hub 时检查插件更新: Check for plugin updates when H hub opens
strings.打开 H hub 时检查并自动更新应用: Check & auto-update H hub when it opens
strings.关闭窗口后核心留在托盘；右键托盘图标可完全退出。更新只在打开界面或点击检查更新时: Closing the window keeps the core in the tray. Right-click the tray icon to exit completely. Updates are checked when you open the interface or request a check. Plugin updates require permission review and approval. App auto-update closes the interface and launches a SHA-256-verified installer. Windows settings use an on-demand process that exits after each operation. Turning off EQ or Phone Remote stops that service and retains its settings.
strings.安装 EQ 插件后可管理应用音频增强。: Install the EQ plugin to apply audio effects by application.
strings.为后台音乐、语音和游戏分别选择 EQ。切换前台场景不会改变这些绑定。: Choose separate EQ settings for background music, voice and games. Foreground scene changes do not alter these bindings.
strings.添加未运行应用: Add app that is not running
strings.当前音频链路未就绪：可保存绑定，设备与路由可用后自动处理。: Audio processing is not ready. Bindings can be saved and will take effect when the device and routing are available.
strings.耳机自身 EQ 会影响全部声音；逐应用 EQ 请使用通用 EQ，并将耳机自身 E: Device hardware EQ affects the entire device. Application EQ uses Universal EQ. To avoid stacking effects, keep hardware EQ flat or off. This plugin does not currently expose independent hardware EQ profiles for scenes.
strings.尚未绑定。添加音乐播放器后，即使游戏在前台，它也会保持自己的 EQ。: No bindings yet. For example, a background music player retains its EQ while a game is in the foreground.
strings.后台播放自动处理 · 等待链路或应用发声: Automatic in background · Waiting for routing or app discovery
strings.请先启动播放应用或添加 EXE，并连接可用的耳机或扬声器。: Start a playing application or add an EXE, and connect available headphones or speakers.
strings.此应用在后台发声时自动使用 EQ: Use EQ automatically while this app runs in the background
strings.每个应用只启用一个输出绑定；更换输出后，原配置仍保留。FxSound 预设包含: Only one output binding is active per app. Changing the output retains its previous settings. FxSound presets include EQ and all five enhancements.
strings.绑定已保存，实际处理状态见音频管理。: Binding saved. See Audio Manager for processing status

strings.添加多个插件库，在插件市场统一搜索和安装。支持仓库地址、HTTPS 清单、本地: Add multiple libraries and browse or install their plugins in one market. Repository URLs, HTTPS manifests, local JSON files and plugin folders are supported.
strings.尚未添加插件库。添加后即可在插件市场浏览插件。: No plugin libraries added. Add one to browse the market.
strings.个插件库 · 点击标题旁的设置按钮管理: libraries · Use the library settings button to manage them

strings.插件包包含 FxSound 官方签名虚拟音频驱动。\n\n实时音效需要安装此驱动:
This plugin includes the officially signed FxSound virtual audio driver.

Live effects require this driver. Windows will ask for administrator permission; a restart may be required. Exit FxSound first.

Hhub processes only bound applications and does not take over other output devices. Choose Later to continue editing and saving curves.

strings.默认优先耳机自身 EQ。通用 EQ 可按应用分别处理；不要叠加两种 EQ。: Use independent hardware EQ when available. Universal EQ can be applied per app. Avoid stacking hardware EQ effects.
